_about: Save slot (lane REBIND, v100), read by SaveSlot.cs. ONE slot file in Application.persistentDataPath: ladder progress (which opponents.json row, fight number) + a pointer to the loot / equipment file that laneLOOTUI's LootSave already owns (loot_save.json, name taken from loot_ui.json save.file, not copied). version = the schema this build writes; a file with a HIGHER version is never overwritten (kept as <file>.v<N>.bak, the run starts fresh in memory); a lower version is migrated. Loaded at boot (BeforeSceneLoad), written at once after every change (victory, next opponent, loot change), tmp file + replace. Harness runs (MenuCfg.Harness) never read or write it. resume.ladder false = always start at opponents.json startIndex.
